title: One mobile platform
Full production system
intro.body: 13m long, 2.5m wide. All major plant units, one trailer. Move it site to site — no dismantling, no reassembly. Faster site prep. Faster commissioning. Easy access for operation, inspection, maintenance.

blocks.title: Material Storage & Dosing
blocks.body: Raw materials, automatically managed. Metered to the exact production recipe. Delivered under controlled conditions. Consistent operation, reliable performance, every batch.

blocks.title: Material Handling
blocks.body: Materials move between process stages — controlled, efficient, continuous. Minimal handling loss. Stable production, start to finish.

blocks.title: Mixing System
blocks.body: A high-performance mixing unit at the core. Homogeneous mixture, every cycle. Consistent distribution. Repeatable quality. Automatic discharge on completion.

blocks.title: Water Supply
blocks.body: Automatic dosing, matched to production parameters. Accurate. Stable. Consistent final product.

blocks.title: Pneumatic System
blocks.body: Compressed air for every automated function. Reliable actuation. Safe, efficient, dependable operation.

blocks.title: Integrated Process Control
blocks.body: Handling to discharge, one coordinated system. Reliability. Repeatability. Efficiency. Consistent quality throughout.

blocks.title: Electronic Control
blocks.body: PLC-driven. Automatic or manual, operator's choice. HMI touchscreen — monitor status, set parameters, adjust settings, select mix designs, respond to alarms. Continuous monitoring of weights, storage levels, sequence, performance. Safe. Accurate. Uninterrupted.

blocks.title: Key advantages of Citrine®
items: Multiple mix designs, stored and ready
Reduced material loss — weighing, conveying, mixing, discharge
Easy access for inspection, cleaning, maintenance
